identitySignals: Name matches: the website spearitwurx.com is for 'SPEARITWURX', which the site describes as California-based and having operated in the Bay Area for 25 years (agenda gives Oakland, CA)

The organization's 'our story' page says co-creator Sizwe Andrews Abakah has worked with Oakland Unified School District's Manhood Development Program, consistent with OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' / Office of Equity contracts
Website describes cultural arts, wellness and healing programs for schools and communities, consistent with the Office of Equity and school-site agreements
research.notes: Legal entity not confirmed. A ProPublica record exists for 'Spearitwurx North Star Inc' (Weed, CA, EIN 39-4413530, exempt since Oct 2025), but it could not be tied to the Oakland-era vendor paid by OUSD (2021-2024; one contract names 'Spearitwurx Foundation'), so no registry IDs are included. The site says the founders now live in Weed, CA. No Oakland address, phone or public email found on the site. Not publishable without a registry match.

profile.summary: Spearitwurx is a California-based organization that creates cultural arts events, community gatherings, professional consulting and wellness coaching focused on wellness across generations. It also offers healing circles, retreats and community education workshops.
